thread:
jess.m: Heads up — thinking about a very low-friction microlaunch this week: 'Starter Prompts + Credit Drip'. Goal = quick activation signal and prompt-template usage benchmark.

sam.g: Love it. Can we keep it to 1 email + 3 social posts + a 30-min office hours? Don't want to overload early adopters.

ana.p: (cc @sam.g) Agree on cadence. Key ask: can we A/B test 50 vs 150 starter credits to see marginal lift on 1st-run prompt completion?

mike.g: Quick idea for messaging variants:
- Variant A: "Build with our Starter Prompts — get 50 free credits"
- Variant B: "Try 150 credits + 10 curated prompt templates"
Which one highlights activation vs exploration.

jess.m: Exactly. Hypothesis: 150 credits will increase prompt experimentation but may lower conversion to paid. We'll measure: 3-day prompt-run rate, 7-day active users, and pct who save a prompt.

lina.ops: Routing note: inbound leads from the webinar signup funnel should get marked for 'starter-credit' tag in HubSpot. Can we add a /source param so Sales sees it?

mike.g: Yes — plan: add ?src=starter-launch to links. Also we'll route traffic to a short landing with 1-click auth + preloaded prompt pack.

ana.p: Landing checklist: 1) Preload 3 prompt templates 2) CTA to claim credits 3) One-click run (no JS heavy flows) 4) analytics events for run/save/share.

jess.m: Draft copy for social and email below — feel free to edit.

```
Email subject: Try 150 free credits + 10 Starter Prompts — ship your first AI feature in minutes
Body: 1-click starter pack, preloaded prompts, and 150 credits to experiment. No credit card required.
CTA: Claim Starter Pack
```

sam.g: Love the short CTA. For social posts, shorter hooks: "Ship a prompt today — 150 free credits" and 2nd post: "Starter Prompts: templates that ship features". Use a short demo GIF.

jess.m: Measurable experiment config (minimal):

```
{
  "experiment": "starter_prompts_credit_drip_v1",
  "variants": ["50_credits", "150_credits"],
  "traffic_split": [50, 50],
  "primary_metric": "3_day_prompt_run_rate",
  "secondary_metrics": ["7_day_active", "prompt_save_rate"]
}
```

mike.g: Can Growth Ops wire up the split in LaunchDarkly? @lina.ops — will we need any additional flags?

lina.ops: Yep — I'll create a flag and the targeting rule for the landing. Also will add a user property starter_credit_amount for reporting. ETA EOD.

growth-bot: Reminder — make sure to include an eval harness to catch quality regressions on the templates. Link: https://internal/evals

ana.p: Also let's keep one control cohort with no free credits for benchmarking (subset of organic signups). Need solid baseline to claim lift.

jess.m: Good call. We'll have three cohorts: control (0), 50, 150. Report cadence: quick daily dashboard for first 72 hours, then a 7-day wrap. Dash to include milestone logs and sample prompts that drove most usage.

sam.g: Who's owning creatives + demo GIF? I can take GIF if someone hands off a short screen recording.

jess.m: @mike.g can you export the demo flows? @sam.g you'll edit. I'll own landing copy + email. @ana.p you'll own analytics + hypothesis doc. @lina.ops will do feature flag + routing.

mike.g: Uploaded demo clip here: https://drive.redwood/demo-starter-gif.mp4

sam.g: I'll edit and drop into the drive by 12pm PT.

jess.m: Timeline: launch soft on Thursday AM (internal), public posts Friday 9am PT, office hours Friday 4pm PT. If performance is strong, scale to paid channels next week.

lina.ops: Routing detail: HubSpot lead source = "starter_prompts_launch", custom property = starter_credit_amount. I'll add to spec.

growth-bot: Quick checklist reminder: UTM params, LD flags, hubspot mapping, analytics events (prompt_run, prompt_save, claim_credit), and eval harness.

jess.m: Cool — next sync 10am tomorrow for final sign-offs. If anyone needs to change copy before then ping me. Thanks all :rocket:
